response.description: A quality that is the extent of space between two entities.
response.label: distance

response.description: A distance which is greater relative to the normal or average.
response.label: increased distance

response.description: A distance which is lesser relative to the normal or average.
response.label: decreased distance

response.description: A distance which is relatively normal or average.
response.label: normal distance

response.description: Shapes are invariant on size transformations. Shapes can be subdivided into 2D and 3D shapes, We can also make a distinction between shapes of complete self-connected objects, and shapes of parts of objects.
response.label: shape

response.description: Length often refers to the longer or longest dimension of an object, however, this is not always true. See https://github.com/pato-ontology/pato/issues/337 for full discussion.
response.label: length

response.description: Width often refers to the dimension that is greater than the extent in only one of the other two orthogonal dimensions, however, this is not always true. See https://github.com/pato-ontology/pato/issues/337 for full discussion.
response.label: width

response.description: A physical quality which is equal to the distance between repeating units of a wave pattern.
response.label: wavelength

response.description: A spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being scattered; spread irregularly, and at a distance from each other.
response.label: sparse

response.description: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's vertical distance of a point above or below a reference surface.
response.label: elevation

response.description: An 1-D extent quality inhering in two-dimensional bearer by virtue of being equal to the distance around it.
response.label: perimeter

response.description: A quality that is the distance between the end of the inserted object and the surface of the object into which it penetrates.
response.label: insertion depth

response.description: A spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located at the same continuous distance relative to another object.
response.label: parallel to

response.description: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing two sides that are at the same continuous distance relative to each other.
response.label: parallel-sided

response.description: A distance traveled in a specific time that is relatively high.
response.label: increased linear velocity

response.description: A distance traveled in a specific time that is relatively low.
response.label: decreased linear velocity

response.description: This is specific to cortical bipolar cells and are distinguished from retinal bipolar cell morphology which has an axon and dendrite emerging from opposite ends of the soma.
response.label: cortical bipolar morphology

response.description: A pyramidal cell morphology that inheres in neurons which lack a clear tuft formation but extend to large radial distances.
response.label: untufted pyramidal morphology

response.description: A pyramidal cell morphology that inheres in neurons which lack a tuft formation but extend to small radial distances forming a star-like shape.
response.label: stellate pyramidal morphology

response.description: An organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's morphological and physiological adaptation for participating in long-distance movement of conspecifics, usually on a seasonal basis.
response.label: migratory
